text.p: Albania were suspended indefinitely by FIFA on Wednesday, following a governmental purge of the Albanian Football Association (AFA).

FIFA, world soccer's governing body, made the decision after the Albanian Ministry of Sport ordered the suspension of the AFA's general secretary Edvard Dervishi and dissolved the executive committee.
FIFA told the AFA that it did not recognise these decisions and would continue to consider Dervishi and the dissolved executive as the only official contacts at the AFA.
The ban puts Albania's World Cup group nine qualifying match against Northern Ireland on December 14 in jeopardy.
Group nine also contains Germany, Portugal, Ukraine and Armenia.
